edit.statement: 'Is adapted from' is reflexive: every work counts as adapted from itself.
edit.subject: adapted_from
edit.original: 'Is adapted from' is irreflexive: an adaptation is made from a different work, so no work is adapted from itself.
edit.scope: Adaptations of one work into another (novel to film, play to musical).
